description: This file defines an enum PlatformLabelFormatter with static methods for parsing and pretty-printing platform label strings such as 'macos', 'ios', etc. It handles trimming, splitting, and formatting version strings for different Apple platforms.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing the prefix in lowercase and optional version string.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Returns a human-readable, formatted platform label based on the parsed prefix and version, e.g., 'macOS 12.3'.
